# Split-signing test vectors

Deterministic cross-language vectors for 2-of-2 additive split RSA signing (split-signing v2, C2/R43).
Generated by `sdk/scripts/gen-split-vectors.py` (stdlib-only Python 3, seed
`realmid-split-vectors/v1/2026-10-27`). Re-running reproduces `vectors.json` byte for byte:
`python3 -I sdk/scripts/gen-split-vectors.py [out.json]`. The script self-checks every value and exits
non-zero on any mismatch. Do not copy this directory under `sdk/go/` (it changes the module hash);
Go tests vendor it from here.

## Scheme

RSA-2048, e = 65537 (R22). `d = d_ri + d_partner (mod lambda(N))`, `d_ri` uniform in `[1, lambda(N))`.
`m` is the EMSA-PKCS1-v1_5 encoding of the SHA-256 digest (`00 01 FF..FF 00 || DigestInfo prefix || digest`,
256 bytes). `s_ri = m^d_ri mod N`, `s_p = m^d_partner mod N`, `s = s_ri * s_p mod N`. A combiner MUST
check `s^e mod N == m` before releasing a token.

## Encoding

Every big integer is lowercase hex, zero-padded to 512 chars (256 bytes); `p` and `q` to 256 chars.
`e` is a JSON number. JWT `signing_input` is `base64url(header_json) "." base64url(payload_json)`, no
padding, header/payload as UTF-8 of the exact `header_json` / `payload_json` strings given. The JWT
signature is `base64url(s as 256 big-endian bytes)`.

## Layout of `vectors.json`

- `key`: `n`, `e`, `lambda_n`, `d`, `d_ri`, `d_partner`, `p`, `q`.
- `jwt_cases[]` (5, one with non-ASCII claims in both header and payload): `name`, `header_json`,
  `payload_json`, `signing_input`, `m`, `s_ri`, `s_p`, `s`, `jwt` (final compact JWT).
- `handshake` (R36): `message = sha256("realmid-split-handshake/v1|" + realm + "|" + kid + "|" + nonce)`,
  32 bytes (`message`, hex), with `realm`, `kid`, `nonce` (base64url) and `preimage` shown. `m` is the
  EMSA encoding that uses `message` DIRECTLY as the digest in DigestInfo (it is not hashed again), then
  `s_ri`, `s_p`, `s`. The format is the plan's `[inferred]` one (v2 § 3); if the issuer settles on another
  construction, regenerate.
- `downgrade` (SPEC 14.6, owner ruling C5 #4): the same construction as `handshake` with the preimage
  `realmid-split-downgrade/v1|<realm>|<kid>|<nonce>` (fields as `handshake`, plus the `preimage` shown).
- `negative_cases[]`: `corrupted-partner-partial` (one bit of `s_p` flipped) and
  `wrong-key-partner-partial` (`s_p` computed from an unrelated key, `wrong_key_n` given). Each carries
  `m`, `s_ri`, `s_p`, `combined_s`, `rejected_jwt` and `expect: "combiner_refuses"`: `combined_s^e mod N != m`.
